lines.en: and false oaths. Mercury, since it is mixed, and swift in motion, and a connected follower, indicates the pursuit of influence,

lines.en: bureaucrats, and scribes, and painters, and merchants, and the people of the market, and of the morals of religion, and knowledge, and purity, and speech, and manners,

lines.text: و صنايع دقيقه و قمر چون اسرع کواکبست دال باشد بر حرکت و انتقال و استحاله و انقلاب
lines.en: and fine crafts. And the Moon, since it is the swiftest of the stars, indicates movement, and transfer, and transformation, and revolution.

summary.headline: Planetary Significations and Aspects
summary.text: Venus, Mercury, and the Moon are assigned significations and associated social types, virtues, vices, and activities. Chapter nineteen introduces the five stellar aspects, explaining trine and sextile as benefic friendship aspects and opposition and square as malefic enmity aspects.
